chunks: Abu'l-Hasan 'Ali b. al-Husayn b. Shaqir al-Hamadani narrated to us in his house in Kufa... from 'Abdullah b. Sinan from Abu 'Abdillah al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad (as). He said:

It was said to the Messenger of Allah (s): Sa'd b. Mu'adh has died. So, the Messenger of Allah (s) stood, and his companions stood with him. While standing at the door, he commanded that Sa'd be washed. When he was embalmed, shrouded, and carried on his coffin, the Messenger of Allah (s) followed him without sandals and without a cloak. He would take to the right of the coffin once and to the left once until he reached the grave. He entered the grave, placed him in the niche, leveled the bricks, and said: Give me stones, give me fresh soil to fill the gaps between the bricks.

When he finished and leveled his grave, the Messenger of Allah (s) said: Surely, I know that he will decay and that decay will reach him, but Allah loves a servant who, when he does a deed, perfects it. When he evened the earth upon him, the mother of Sa'd said: O Sa'd! Congratulations to you on Paradise. So the Messenger of Allah (s) said: O mother of Sa'd! Stop, do not make assumptions about your Lord, for Sa'd has been afflicted with constriction.

So the Messenger of Allah (s) returned, and the people returned. They said: O Messenger of Allah! We saw you do for Sa'd what you have not done for anyone else. You followed his funeral without cloak and without sandals. He said: The angels were without cloaks and sandals, so I did the same. They said: You took to the right of the coffin once and to the left once. He said: My hand was in the hand of Gabriel (as), going where he took me. They said: You commanded his washing, prayed upon his funeral, and placed him in his grave, then you said: 'Sa'd has been afflicted with constriction.' He said: Yes. He had poor character when dealing with his family.

key_terms.جِبْرَئِيل: The archangel Gabriel (Jibril), who guided the Prophet during the funeral
key_terms.خُلُقِهِ مَعَ أَهْلِهِ سُوء: Poor character with one's family, the reason for Sa'd's grave constriction
key_terms.ضَمَّة: Constriction of the grave (dammat al-qabr), a punishment or trial in the grave

ai.seo_question: Why did Sa'd b. Mu'adh suffer constriction in the grave despite the Prophet's special treatment at his funeral?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq narrates the funeral of Sa'd b. Mu'adh. The Prophet attended with exceptional devotion: walking barefoot and without cloak (imitating the angels), alternating sides of the coffin (guided by Gabriel), and personally preparing the grave. Despite all this honor, the Prophet warned Sa'd's mother not to presume Paradise, as Sa'd suffered constriction in his grave due to his poor character with his family.

en.bilal-muhammad: Abu’l Hasan `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Shaqir b. Ya`qub b. al-Harith b. Ibrahim al-Hamadani narrated to us in his house in Kufa. He said: Abu `Abdillah Ja`far b. Ahmad b. Yusuf al-Azdi narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Bazraj al-Hannat narrated to us. He said: `Amr b. Alyasa` narrated to us from `Abdullah b. Alyasa` from `Abdullah b. Sinan from Abi `Abdillah al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as). He said:

It was said to the Messenger of Allah (sw): Sa`d b. Mu`adh has died. So, the Messenger of Allah (sw) stood, and his companions stood with him. While he was standing at the door, he commanded that Sa`d was to be washed. When he was embalmed, shrouded, and carried on his coffin, the Messenger of Allah (sw) followed him without sandals and without a cloak. He would take to the right of the coffin once and to the left of the coffin once until he ended up at the grave. So, the Messenger of Allah (sw) entered the grave and settled it, saying: Give me stones, and give me fresh soil to fill in the gaps.

When he finished preparing his grave, the Messenger of Allah (sw) said: Surely, I know that he will be afflicted, and that affliction will reach him, but Allah loves a servant that does an act that He proscribed. When he evened the dust on him, the mother of Sa`d said: O Sa`d! Congratulations to you on Paradise. So, the Messenger of Allah (sw) said: O mother of Sa`d! Stop, and do not make assumptions for your Lord, for Sa`d has been afflicted with constriction [in his grave].

He said: So, the Messenger of Allah (sw) returned, and the people returned. So, they said to him: O Messenger of Allah! We have seen you do for Sa`d that which we have not seen you do for anyone else. You followed his funeral without sandals and without a cloak. So, he (sw) said: The angels were without their cloaks and without their sandals, so I did the same. They said: You took to the right of the coffin once and to the left of the coffin once. He said: My hand was in the hand of Gabriel (as), and I went where he took me. They said: You commanded that he be washed, and you offered his funeral prayer, and placed him in his grave, then you said: “Sa`d has been afflicted with constriction.” So, he (sw) said: Yes. He had poor character when dealing with his family.
